lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Pip reaches the harbor steps, out of breath, trumpet case still swinging.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: I outran the police. I lose races to buses. Parked buses.

lines.speaker: quill
lines.text: Citizens of Port Murmur. Quiet is a public good. Please enjoy it responsibly.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: She said that through a megaphone.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Nice getaway, kid. Most people in this town run from the music. You ran with it.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: If you want to play where the meters can't reach, find the Brass Cellar. Ask for Ruby.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: The Brass Cellar. Okay. One more song, then.
